name: convention-exclude-globs
description: A file a row's entry glob names and its exclude glob names as well is no root, so it is reported as a file nothing imports, while the page beside it is a root. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named astro for the package astro, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name the files below src/pages and whose exclude globs name a file there whose name starts with an underscore.
